# EtsyArtPacker

> Free open-source browser tool that turns one master artwork into 5 standard Etsy wall-art ratios at genuine 300 DPI — no upload, 100% private.

## Core Features

- Drag-and-drop master image processing entirely in the browser.
- Auto-crops to 5 standard gallery ratios: 2:3, 3:4, 4:5, ISO, 11:14.
- Injects real 300 DPI metadata into each file.
- Downloads an Etsy-ready ZIP with organized folders.
- Zero server upload; all files stay on the user's device.

## Pricing

- Free forever for all current features.
- No credit card required.
- Optional Pro / bulk tier may be introduced later; the free tier will remain available.

## API & Docs

- No public API at this time.
- Open-source repository: https://github.com/XuChenXinXc/etsy-art-packer
- Documentation and comparison guides: https://etsyartpacker.com/
